summary: Motion 2.0 batch 3: stable search results and interruption-safe suggestions

changes.title: Stable Emoji Search results
changes.detail: Keep identical final result rows intact, including scroll and current animation; animate replacements from their visible opacity rather than fading the entire row.

changes.title: Search touch continuity
changes.detail: Cancel obsolete search gestures when results change; completed Search taps dispatch immediately instead of a delayed callback against replaced keys. Browse behavior is unchanged.

changes.title: Scale Improved retargeting
changes.detail: Sample the last recorded glyph draw when interrupted, rather than a scheduled future frame. The original Scale preset is unchanged.
